name: cambench
title: Cambench
description: Every camera's specs, read through Firecrawl from B&H, the makers' own sites and press releases, DPReview, launch news, Wikipedia, MPB and eBay, read by agents against one set of ~45 specs and verified across independent sources. Its workflow fetches, reads, settles disagreements, reviews pictures and publishes the results to darkgrade.com/cambench.
